rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a child whose parent or parents have died.

example.english: They became an orphan after their parents died.
example.traditional: 佢父母過身之後，就成咗孤兒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fu6 mou5 gwo3 san1 zi1 hau6 zau6 sing4 zo2 gu1 ji4

rows.note: Use this more colloquial, sympathetic form when referring specifically to an orphaned child, especially a young one.

example.english: That orphan lost their parents so young; it is really tragic.
example.traditional: 嗰個孤兒仔咁細個就冇咗父母，真係好慘。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gu1 ji4 zai2 gam3 sai3 go3 zau6 mou5 zo2 fu6 mou5 zan1 hai6 hou2 caam2
